notes: Bundler-plugin route: bugseeRollupPlugin from @bugsee/bundler-plugin-core injects debug ids and uploads source maps at build time. Source maps must be enabled (output.sourcemap); the wizard only reports that switch, it never edits it. The plugin reads the app token from BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN. Reading .env.bugsee-build-plugin itself only lands with JS issue #182: until then, export BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN in CI (and locally to upload from a local build).
